categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 多模态Agent、强化学习信用分配与自动化科研是主线，核心都在提升复杂任务中的分工与评估能力。

articles.title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
articles.zh: 面向多模态临床诊断的排序感知提示优化
articles.summary: 如果你在做医疗多模态模型的prompt调优，这篇把诊断候选的排序质量直接写进优化目标，而不是只看单次答案对错
articles.author: Tian Xia, Minghao Liu 等
articles.body: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.
articles.bodyZh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正在快速推进临床诊断，但它们的适配流程仍然锚定在基于准确率的目标上。临床数据存在严重的类别不平衡：一个永远只猜多数的模型可以拿到90%以上的准确率，却在临床上毫无用处。因此，我们改为评估和优化AUROC——一种无需设定阈值的评分，它衡量的是正例是否排在负例之上，并且不受类别比例影响。我们聚焦于MLLMs中的提示词优化。像GEPA这样的反思式方法使用一个二值分数矩阵，每一行对应一个评估实例，每一列对应一个候选提示词；单元格记录的是每个实例是否正确，因此列平均值就是准确率，并驱动候选选择。我们提出了配对级帕累托提示进化（Ranking-PE），它把每一行正确性替换为在（正例，负例）实例对上的成对排序行：如果候选提示词给正例的分数高于配对的负例，单元格就是1。这样列平均值就等于经验AUROC（依据Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney恒等式）。我们在提示进化搜索所读取的全部三个层面上应用这一替换——决定帕累托支配关系的分数矩阵、给反思LM的逐样本反馈，以及最终的候选选择——不增加任何额外的模型调用，也不使用替代损失。在MIMIC上的三种疾病中，基于准确率的提示进化可能损害排序能力；Ranking-PE扭转了这一点，在微调后的Qwen3-VL-8B上比基于准确率的方案高出+5.8个AUROC百分点，在MedGemma-4B上高出+16.2个百分点。消融实验考察了每个设计组件，并表明医学级视觉骨干网络——通过视觉编码器调优的SFT或医学预训练获得——是一个提示搜索无法替代的前提条件——我们的方案将反思式提示进化从纯文本数据扩展到了多模态临床决策。

articles.title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization
articles.zh: 半反事实信用增强的策略优化
articles.summary: 如果你在调强化学习的信用分配，这篇用"半反事实"给中间步骤更合理的功劳归属，值得对比一下你现在的做法
articles.author: Junshu Pan, Zhizhang Fu 等
articles.body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights. These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment. SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone. On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024-2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively. At both model scales, SCAPO achieves the best results on most evaluated mathematics benchmarks and all evaluated out-of-distribution benchmarks among the compared methods. These results suggest that semifactual stability provides an effective training signal for improving reasoning and generalization through finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR. The code is available at https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO.
articles.bodyZh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards，RLVR）确实让大语言模型（large language models，LLMs）的推理能力变强了，但它们的预测还是很容易受题目里那些跟任务无关的提示特征（task-irrelevant prompt features）影响。我们通过半反事实提示干预（semifactual prompt interventions）来研究这种敏感性——也就是改一改提示，但保证底层问题和答案不变。分析发现，token 级别的敏感度（token-level sensitivity）差别很大；如果在解码（decoding）时压住那些高漂移 token 候选（high-drift token candidates），不用更新模型权重，就能提升推理准确率。这些发现暴露了组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization，GRPO）的一个局限：它把同一个由最终结果算出来的优势值（outcome-derived advantage）发给每个回答 token，结果可能在强化有用推理的同时，也强化了潜在的虚假依赖（spurious dependence）。受这个观察启发，我们提出了半反事实信用增强策略优化（Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization，SCAPO），它是 GRPO 的一个带因果思路的变体，把半反事实稳定性（semifactual stability）加入 token 级信用分配（token-level credit assignment）。SCAPO 会衡量固定回答在半反事实干预下的 token 概率漂移（token probability drift），再用归一化稳定性分数（normalized stability scores）在训练早期降低那些相对不稳定的 token 的优势值，但不会因为稳定本身就额外给奖励。在 Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 上，SCAPO 把 AIME 2024-2026 的准确率分别比 GRPO 提高了 5.63 和 4.17 个百分点。在两个模型规模上，和其他对比方法相比，SCAPO 在大多数被评估的数学基准上都拿到最好结果，在所有被评估的分布外（out-of-distribution）基准上也全部最好。这些结果说明，半反事实稳定性提供了一种有效的训练信号，能通过在 RLVR 里做更细粒度的信用分配，提升推理能力和泛化能力。代码在 https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO 可以拿到。

articles.title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
articles.zh: ViTeX-Bench：高保真视频场景文本编辑基准
articles.summary: 如果你要评估"视频里改字"的效果，这个基准专盯高保真度，能帮你识别那些一播放就穿帮的方案
articles.author: Xinghao Chen, Xiangbo Gao 等
articles.body: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together. We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.
articles.bodyZh: 最近，视频生成（video generation）越来越逼真，也越来越可控了，但视频编辑（video editing）这块还比较落后，尤其是那种必须保住原场景动态（scene dynamics）的精确局部编辑（local edits）。视频场景文字编辑（video scene text editing）就是把画面表面上、比如店铺招牌、白板、产品标签上的文字换掉，同时还得保留周围的内容、运动和镜头动态（camera dynamics）。虽然图像上的场景文字编辑（scene text editing）已经研究得挺透了，但放到视频里，要想同时做到高画质、时间一致性（temporal consistency）和编辑局部性（edit locality），现在研究得还不够。现有资源里，配对的真实视频数据（paired real-video data）很有限，而且通用的视频编辑指标（video-editing metrics）也没法直接衡量你要求改的文字在整段时间里是不是一直正确。为此，我们推出了 ViTeX-Bench，这是一套基准测试套件（benchmark suite），包含 ViTeX-Dataset 和一个三轴评估协议（evaluation protocol）。这个数据集有 387 段真实世界的 720p 视频，带文字区域掩码（text-region masks）和编辑指令（editing instructions）：其中 230 段提供了经过审核、由流水线生成的配对编辑结果，用来训练；另外 157 段则是冻结的评估集（evaluation split）。这个协议用 13 个指标来评估文字正确性（text correctness）、视觉和时间质量（visual and temporal quality）、以及编辑局部性，每个轴有一个主指标，还会对它们之间的取舍做帕累托比较（Pareto comparison）。OCR 校准（OCR calibration）、人工评估（human evaluation）和标注敏感性分析（annotation-sensitivity analyses）用来支撑这些分数的解读。我们试了来自四个编辑家族的八种基线（baselines），结果发现，文字准确、时间稳定、场景保留这三件事还是很难一起做到。我们还发布了 ViTeX-Edit-14B，这是一个开源参考编辑器（reference editor），在配对训练集上做了微调，并用了运动对齐的字形-视频条件（motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning）。它拿到 CharAcc 0.688，在被评估的视频原生编辑器（video-native editors）里平均分最高；在原始编辑器输出里，文本裁剪 Warp（text-crop Warp）也做到了可比结果中最低。ViTeX-Bench 给研究视频场景文字编辑里的这些取舍提供了一个可复现的基础。

articles.title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery
articles.zh: EvoDuet：面向科学发现的网络搜索与任务求解双层协同演化
articles.summary: 如果你想让Agent自己搞科研，这篇让"搜什么"和"解什么"互相进化，而不是检索和推理各干各的
articles.author: Young-Jun Lee, Jinheon Baek 等
articles.body: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. We introduce EvoDuet, a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters. At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without them. An inner loop refines queries and ranks documents by the solution scores they are predicted to yield; an outer loop generates candidates in parallel from these documents and records the evaluated outcomes for later searches. Across 21 optimization tasks with one candidate per iteration, EvoDuet raises OpenEvolve's normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit. Our best runs surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks, including Swap Reduction on Q20 and Rosetta, and match them on three more. EvoDuet also improves with other scaffolds (e.g., Top-K, EvoX) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, demonstrating its applicability across evolutionary search scaffolds.
articles.bodyZh: 用大型语言模型（LLMs）来做进化搜索（evolutionary search）时，如果继续往前走需要模型自己没有的外部知识，搜索就会卡住。给它喂相关文档会有帮助，但如果只是加个网页搜索工具，随着解法不断变化，它可能一直返回同样的页面。我们提出 EvoDuet，这是一种双层优化（bi-level optimization）方法，在模型参数固定的情况下，让解和搜索查询协同进化。每次迭代时，一个检索门控（retrieval gate）会让 LLM 先判断自己缺不缺知识，再选择去检索新文档、复用已经存下来的文档，还是不用文档继续推进。内层循环（inner loop）会优化查询，并按这些文档预计能带来的解得分来给文档排序；外层循环（outer loop）则从这些文档并行生成候选解，并记录评估结果，供后续搜索使用。在 21 个优化任务上、每次迭代只生成一个候选解的条件下，EvoDuet 在使用 GPT-5.6-Luna 时，把 OpenEvolve 的归一化发现增益（normalized discovery gain）从 74.1% 提高到 78.0%；在使用 Gemini-3.8-Flash 时，从 61.3% 提高到 82.3%；但 Qwen3.5-9B 并没有从中受益。我们最好的几轮结果在 8 个任务上超过了此前报告的最佳分数，包括 Q20 和 Rosetta 上的 Swap Reduction，并在另外 3 个任务上追平。在 Sums/Diffs 和 Denoising 上，EvoDuet 搭配其他脚手架（scaffolds，比如 Top-K、EvoX）也能提升效果，说明它能跨不同的进化搜索脚手架使用。

articles.title: Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization
articles.zh: Turbo Harness：实例自适应的Harness优化
articles.summary: 如果你在搭Agent评测或调harness，这篇按实例动态改配置，省掉一套参数跑到底的浪费
articles.author: Tunyu Zhang, Hao Wang 等
articles.body: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates. Through numerical experiments, we show that Turbo Harness consistently outperforms existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.
articles.bodyZh: 把寻找好用外壳（harness）这件事自动化，是让智能体（agent）实现递归式自我改进（recursively self-improve）的重要一步。现有的外壳优化方法，基本上都是搞出一个单一的全局外壳（global harness），然后所有任务实例（task instance）都统一套用这一个。可问题在于，平均表现好的外壳，放到每一个具体实例上未必就是最优的。于是我们提出了 Turbo Harness，这是一个能把全局优化好的外壳逐个实例做适配的框架，办法是复用最初优化过程中产生的信息。具体来说，Turbo Harness 会把一次完整的全局外壳优化跑完之后留下的各种中间产物（artifact）回收起来，整理归纳成一本结构化的攻略手册（playbook）。接着我们训练一个外壳编辑器（harness editor），让它借助这些过往的优化经验，针对具体实例给全局外壳生成专属补丁（patch）。到了推理阶段，编辑器会拿当前实例加上这本攻略手册，现场搭出一个量身定制的外壳，执行模型（execution model）就在里面干活。我们做了大量数值实验，结果显示，在横跨交互式智能体任务、软件工程和长时程终端任务（long-horizon terminal task）这七项基准测试（benchmark）上，Turbo Harness 都稳定压过现有的外壳优化基线方法（baseline）。

articles.title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
articles.zh: WorldAuditBench：用多模态Agent做交互式3D世界审计
articles.summary: 如果你关心多模态Agent到底懂不懂3D世界，这个基准用交互审计把"看着像懂"和"真的懂"区分开
articles.author: Ziyan Jiang, Jingbo Yang 等
articles.body: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js, spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.
articles.bodyZh: 现在交互式3D世界越来越多地被用来研究智能行为，所以咱们就特别需要一套好用的流程，能高效找出这些模拟环境里的异常，比如漂浮的物体、能穿过去的墙，或者跟周围场景对不上的东西。多模态AI系统（multimodal AI systems），比如视觉语言模型（VLMs）和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs），已经显示出把这件事自动化的潜力。不过，3D世界审计（3D world auditing）这件事本身很复杂，得把两种能力紧紧拧在一起：一个是行动（action），也就是在3D世界里导航，既系统又高效地搜索异常；另一个是视觉推理（visual reasoning），也就是理解环境，并从多模态观察里识别异常。多模态智能体到底能不能把这两种能力有效结合起来——一边用视觉推理找出潜在异常，一边采取行动去验证——目前基本还没人深入探索过。在这篇论文里，我们推出了WorldAuditBench，这是一个3D世界审计基准（benchmark），包含213个异常任务，分布在13个用Unreal Engine 5和Three.js搭出来的环境里，涵盖五大类异常（anomaly families）。我们在固定的探索预算（exploration budget）下，用两种审计范式（auditing paradigms）评测了五个前沿模型（frontier models）：一种是先用VLA去探索，再用VLM来识别异常；另一种是端到端的VLM智能体（end-to-end VLM agent），让视觉推理直接指导它选什么动作。在这些被评测的模型和两种范式里，成功率从6.6%到42.3%不等，跟人类表现（human performance，83.4%）比差了一大截。通过世界审计这个任务，WorldAuditBench给大家提供了一个试验台（testbed），用来研究多模态智能体在交互式3D环境里到底怎么把行动和视觉推理结合起来，同时也暴露出它们目前在探索过程中收集和解读证据的能力还有哪些短板。

articles.title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
articles.zh: Cogentic：面向自动证明发现的多Agent编排
articles.summary: 如果你在搞自动定理证明，这篇用多Agent分工找证明，比单模型硬刚更有希望
articles.author: Yang Cai, Vineet Gupta 等
articles.body: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove--verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using Gemini as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on five open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic .
articles.bodyZh: 我们推出 Cogentic，这是一套多智能体框架（multi-agent harness），专门用来在开放研究问题（open research problems）上自动发现证明（automated proof discovery）。前沿语言模型（frontier language models）虽然能一次性给出很强的数学想法，但对于那些需要探索多个互相竞争的猜想（conjecture）、跨过一些很微妙的技术障碍（technical obstruction），还要在很长的时间跨度里保住中间进展（intermediate progress）的开放问题来说，单次生成（single-shot generation）往往不够。Cogentic 用一套迭代式“证明—验证”循环（iterative prove--verify loop）来应对这些挑战：一个编排器（orchestrator）会把一群彼此独立的证明智能体（prover）分配到不同的证明方向（proof direction）上，让几个专门组件（specialized component）对它们的产出做对抗式验证（adversarial verification），再把已经确认的中间结果提升到一个持久化的已验证账本（persistent verified ledger）里，后面的轮次就基于它继续往前推。这套框架的目标，是能够解决研究级数学（research-level math）和理论计算机科学（theoretical computer science）问题。以 Gemini 作为基础模型，Cogentic 在在线学习（online learning）、拍卖理论（auction theory）和机制设计（mechanism design）的五个开放问题上做出了新结果。每个结果都由领域专家（domain expert）独立验证，并在配套论文（companion paper）里完整展开。我们把这些结果，以及之后每验证一个就补上的新结果，都列在 https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic 上。

articles.title: MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space
articles.zh: MatLoom：紧凑程序空间中的分层文本到材质生成
articles.summary: 如果你做3D材质生成，这篇把材质拆成分层程序表示，用文本拼出可编辑材质，而不是给你一张死贴图
articles.author: Anson Y. Lam, Shuqing Li 等
articles.body: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom, a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate's remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 participants and 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2% of choices, compared with 19.3% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.
articles.bodyZh: 材质生成不仅要产出外观，还要产出构建它的规则。我们推出 MatLoom，这是一种紧凑、面向层的语言，用于借助预训练语言模型进行文本到材质生成。每个程序都会组合带 alpha 遮罩的层，这些层共享的空间表达式定义了覆盖范围以及基于物理的渲染（PBR）通道，从而使图案、颜色和浮雕之间的依赖关系变得明确。一个独立的解释器会把程序求值为材质贴图，而源代码则保留命名字段和层参数，供后续创作使用。我们的流程无需针对特定任务进行微调，而是使用解析器引导的修复和基于预览的评判来修订材质设计，然后在保持每个候选方案其余源代码不变的情况下搜索噪声种子。在一个由 141 条提示组成、并用六个主干模型评估的精选基准上，我们表现最好的配置在全部四项平面布局提示对齐指标上的平均得分都高于三个扩散基线。它的初始程序在平均 BLIPScore 上就已经超过全部三个基线，而且这是在评判或种子搜索之前。汇总各个主干模型后，保留下来的程序长度中位数为 21 行。在一项涉及 30 名参与者和 20 条提示的盲测四选一比较中，我们的渲染结果获得了 59.2% 的选择，而最受偏好的基线为 19.3%。因此，紧凑的可执行程序提供了一种方式，既能生成与提示对齐的材质，又能把它们的构建过程保留为资产的一部分。
